name: trihex
comment: The 3 one-sided trihexes (3 free, 0 of them a mirror twin): unions of unit HEXAGONS on the honeycomb; boundary corners 120°/240°. Generated by alphabets/gen_polyform_palette.py hex 3; every tile is the `polyomino` kind, which is just a cyclic interior-angle word, so the lattice never reaches the search. Chirality is DISTINGUISHED (X ≠ X'), the shelf convention and a deliberate departure from the A068599 mirror-merge one. EXPLORATORY: no external oracle exists for k-uniform polyform tilings, so counts are observations.
